payment_channel.meaning: how the money reached the plan; not_applicable on charges

balance_effect.meaning: what the entry did to the outstanding balance once posted

source_premium_entry_id.meaning: the charge a credit or a state payment relieves; empty on an original charge

adjustment_reason_code.meaning: why a credit was posted; not_applicable on charges and payments

remittance_reference.meaning: the payment reference on the member's statement or the state's remittance file, recorded exactly as stated

snp_care_record_id.meaning: primary id of the care management record

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the charter

record_date.meaning: date the assessment or review took place

assessment_type.meaning: which care management activity this row records

risk_stratification.meaning: the risk band the assessment placed the member in, which sets how often they are reviewed

care_manager_npi.meaning: the care manager who carried out the activity

next_review_due_date.meaning: date the next review falls due; empty where none is scheduled

contact_attempt_number.meaning: which attempt to reach the member this row records, so repeated attempts on one day stay separate rows

source_care_record_id.meaning: the assessment this review follows on from; empty on an initial assessment

snp_enrollment_request_id.meaning: primary id of the Special Needs Plan enrollment intake record

snp_enrollment_id.meaning: the enrollment this intake concerns; empty for a brand-new application

request_action.meaning: what the member asked the plan to do

requested_variant_name.meaning: the official plan name the member asked for, recorded exactly as stated; empty where the request is not a plan election

requested_effective_date.meaning: the coverage start or end date the member asked for

special_needs_evidence.meaning: what the plan holds to show the qualifying special need; the only authority for accepting the election

intake_status.meaning: how far the intake has progressed

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by the handling clock

egwp_enrollment_id.meaning: primary id of the group retiree enrollment record

variant_name.meaning: the group retiree plan held, written as the official plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the enrollment (basis defined in lifecycle.states)

group_number.meaning: the employer or union group contract this retiree is enrolled under

group_sponsor_name.meaning: the employer or union that sponsors the group, recorded as it appears on the group contract

subscriber_reference.format: the sponsor's own retiree identifier, eight to twelve characters
subscriber_reference.meaning: the reference the sponsor uses for this retiree on its eligibility file

relationship_to_subscriber.meaning: who this person is on the sponsor's retiree roster, which decides who may change the enrollment

plan_year.meaning: CMS contract year this enrollment belongs to

eligibility_file_received_date.meaning: date the sponsor's eligibility file naming this retiree reached the plan

coverage_effective_date.meaning: first day coverage is in force; always the first day of a month

coverage_end_date.meaning: last day coverage is in force; empty while the enrollment has not ended

premium_responsibility.meaning: who pays the group premium, which decides whether the retiree is billed at all

retiree_contribution_amount.meaning: the monthly share of the premium the sponsor has set for this retiree

premium_balance_due.meaning: outstanding retiree contribution owed; identically the sum of the premium_receivable account deltas

collection_method.meaning: how the retiree's share reaches the plan

disenrollment_reason_code.meaning: why the enrollment ended; not_applicable while it has not ended

egwp_premium_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the group retiree premium ledger entry

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the charter

billing_period.meaning: the coverage month this entry belongs to

amount.meaning: absolute value of the entry in dollars; the direction is carried by the event family

payer_side.meaning: which side of the split premium this entry is, so that the sponsor's share and the retiree's for one month stay separate rows

collection_channel.meaning: how the money reached the plan; not_applicable on charges and credits

balance_effect.meaning: what the entry did to the outstanding balance once posted

source_premium_entry_id.meaning: the charge a credit relieves; empty on charges and payments

credit_reason_code.meaning: why a credit was posted; not_applicable on charges and payments

remittance_reference.meaning: the payment reference on the retiree's pension advice or bank statement, recorded exactly as stated

egwp_group_change_id.meaning: primary id of the group change record

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the charter

change_type.meaning: what the change was, which decides who had to authorise it

change_source.meaning: who the change came from; a change only the retiree may make is never accepted from the sponsor's file alone

effective_date.meaning: first day the change applies from

prior_value.meaning: what the record said before the change, recorded exactly as it stood

new_value.meaning: what the record says after the change, recorded exactly as instructed

file_cycle_reference.meaning: which eligibility file cycle carried the change, so two changes of the same kind in one month stay separate rows

reconciliation_status.meaning: how the change stands against the plan's own reconciliation of the roster

source_change_id.meaning: the change this correction puts right; empty on an original change

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity verification record

customer_id.meaning: member whose identity was checked (foreign key -> customers)

verified.meaning: whether the caller's identity was verified on this member profile; once true it never returns to false

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by the handling clock
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent identity check on this profile

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

customer_id.meaning: member handed over to a human representative (foreign key -> customers)

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by the handling clock
